decisions.reason: The source replaces hero text but does not require any change to the independently specified hero image, mobile-phone presentation, buttons, or media layout.
Replacing copy within the existing hero section does not change the landing page's content categories, specification source, screenshot selection, or overall architecture.
The reference to emailing a vehicle sales page describes the product in hero copy and does not alter contact-form submission delivery or its recipients.
The source changes textual content only and does not modify the approved visual style, colour source, or design reference.
The hero-copy replacement has no effect on the Webflow platform or hosting-plan choice.
The new hero copy neither introduces nor requests animation and leaves the animation-free presentation requirement unchanged.
The source is explicitly limited to copy in the first hero section and does not affect the replacement image at the bottom of the page.
The hero-copy replacement does not mention or alter the dealer-login button or its top-right-only placement.
